days.title: Development Environment Setup
objectives: Set up an isolated Python environment with venv or conda
Pin and manage dependencies with requirements.txt
Use Git and GitHub for version control and branching
Run and debug notebooks in VS Code and Jupyter
Store secrets safely with .env files and environment variables

days.title: Python Foundations for AI
objectives: Work with core Python data structures for AI workloads
Write typed, modular Python using functions and classes
Use async/await to run concurrent API calls
Validate and parse data with Pydantic models
Handle exceptions and structure logging cleanly

days.title: APIs, HTTP & Your First LLM Call
objectives: Understand REST verbs, status codes and JSON payloads
Authenticate to a third-party API with API keys
Make a first LLM completion call and read the response object
Handle rate limits, timeouts and retries
Read API documentation to find the right endpoint and parameters

days.title: Data Collection & Ingestion
objectives: Ingest data from CSV, JSON, SQL and API sources
Scrape and parse HTML responsibly
Design a raw data storage layout for a project
Handle encoding issues, schema drift and malformed records

days.title: Data Cleaning & Preparation
objectives: Clean, deduplicate and normalize messy datasets
Handle missing values and outliers deliberately
Standardize text fields with regular expressions
Strip or mask PII before downstream use
Profile a dataset before building on top of it

days.title: Text Processing, Chunking & SQL
objectives: Tokenize text and reason about token budgets
Choose chunk size and overlap for retrieval quality
Attach metadata to chunks for later filtering
Query relational data with SQL joins, filters and aggregates

days.title: Embeddings Explained
objectives: Explain what an embedding vector actually represents
Generate embeddings with Sentence Transformers and the OpenAI API
Compare cosine similarity, dot product and Euclidean distance
Visualize embedding clusters with PCA and interpret them
Choose an embedding model for a specific domain and cost budget

days.title: Vector Databases: Local vs Managed
objectives: Compare local stores (ChromaDB, FAISS) with managed ones (Pinecone)
Create collections, namespaces and indexes
Understand ANN indexing and the recall vs latency trade-off
Plan for persistence, scaling and cost of a vector store

days.title: Building the Retrieval Layer
objectives: Load embeddings and metadata into a vector store
Implement semantic search with top-k retrieval
Apply metadata filtering to narrow the candidate set
Tune k and similarity thresholds against real queries
Evaluate retrieval quality by inspecting results

days.title: Hybrid Search & Query Routing
objectives: Route a query to SQL lookup, vector search or a hybrid path
Combine keyword and semantic results into one ranked list
Deduplicate and re-rank retrieved chunks
Handle queries where no chunk is a good match

days.title: RAG Pipeline Fundamentals
objectives: Wire retrieval into a grounded generation prompt
Swap LLM providers (OpenAI, Ollama, Groq) behind a single interface
Reduce hallucination by grounding answers in retrieved context
Handle context window limits when stuffing chunks
Measure whether an answer is actually grounded in its sources

days.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
objectives: Apply zero-shot, few-shot and chain-of-thought prompting
Design a system prompt with role, constraints and output format
Control tone, verbosity and response structure
Iterate on prompts using concrete failure examples
Recognize when prompting is the wrong tool for the problem

days.title: Function Calling & Structured Outputs
objectives: Define tool schemas the model can call reliably
Parse and validate structured outputs with Pydantic
Handle invalid, partial or hallucinated JSON from the model
Feed a tool result back into the conversation loop

days.title: Fine-Tuning Foundations: LoRA & PEFT
objectives: Explain how LoRA adapters modify a base model without full retraining
Prepare and format a fine-tuning dataset
Run a LoRA fine-tune and monitor training loss
Evaluate the fine-tuned model against the base model

days.title: QLoRA & Fine-Tuning Trade-offs
objectives: Use quantization (QLoRA) to fine-tune on limited GPU memory
Compare fine-tuning, prompting and RAG on cost, data volume and maintenance
Decide when fine-tuning is actually justified
Avoid overfitting and catastrophic forgetting

days.title: FastAPI Chat Backend
objectives: Build a /chat endpoint with typed request and response models
Manage per-user sessions and conversation state
Structure the app into routers, services and schemas
Return proper status codes and handle errors

days.title: Streamlit Chat UI
objectives: Build a chat interface with st.chat_message and st.chat_input
Maintain conversation history in session state
Connect the UI to the FastAPI backend
Handle loading, empty and error states

days.title: Streaming Responses with SSE
objectives: Stream tokens from the LLM using Server-Sent Events
Implement StreamingResponse and an async generator in FastAPI
Render tokens incrementally in the client
Handle disconnects, partial responses and cancellation

days.title: Citations & Rich Response Rendering
objectives: Attach source citations to generated answers
Render structured cards and Markdown safely
Link each answer back to the retrieved chunks that produced it
Design responses for trust and transparency

days.title: Conversation Memory & Persistence
objectives: Persist conversations and messages in SQLite
Summarize older turns to keep context under control
Manage token budgets across a long conversation
Reload session history when a user reconnects

days.title: LangChain Agents & the ReAct Pattern
objectives: Explain the ReAct reason-act-observe loop
Wrap Python functions as agent tools with good descriptions
Debug agent traces and wrong tool selection
Bound agent loops, retries and cost

days.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
objectives: Design a router agent that delegates to specialist agents
Model state, nodes and edges in LangGraph
Coordinate roles and hand-offs in CrewAI
Avoid infinite loops, redundant work and runaway cost

days.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
objectives: Explain what MCP standardizes between clients and servers
Build an MCP server that exposes tools and resources
Connect an MCP client to that server
Compare MCP tools with framework-native tool definitions

days.title: Full Agentic Integration
objectives: Combine agents, MCP tools, retrieval and memory in one system
Design error handling and fallbacks across components
Trace a single request end to end through the system
Decide what the agent must not be allowed to do

days.title: LLM Evaluation & Benchmarking
objectives: Build a benchmark dataset of question and answer pairs
Measure accuracy, grounding and consistency
Use LLM-as-judge carefully and know its failure modes
Track regressions across prompt and model versions

days.title: Token Optimization, Caching & Latency
objectives: Count and reduce tokens per request
Cache responses and embeddings to cut cost
Benchmark latency across providers and model sizes
Trade off cost, latency and answer quality explicitly

days.title: AI Security & Safety
objectives: Defend against prompt injection and jailbreak attempts
Validate and sanitize user input at the API boundary
Protect PII and secrets in prompts, logs and traces
Apply authentication, authorization and rate limiting to AI endpoints

days.title: Containerization & Deployment
objectives: Write a production Dockerfile for an AI service
Configure health checks and readiness probes
Deploy and scale on Kubernetes or a managed host
Manage secrets and configuration per environment

days.title: Monitoring, Logging & Observability
objectives: Emit structured logs for every LLM call
Expose latency, token and error metrics to Prometheus
Build a Grafana dashboard for an AI service
Track and alert on failure patterns and quality drift

days.title: End-to-End Production Testing & Documentation
objectives: Write integration tests across the full pipeline
Load test the API and find the real bottleneck
Document setup, architecture and operational runbooks
Prepare a rollback plan for a bad deploy

days.title: Capstone Demo
objectives: Present a complete AI system end to end
Justify architecture decisions and their trade-offs
Demonstrate evaluation results and known limitations
Outline what the next iteration would change
